# Orvio 0.26

- IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes scores are fetched ahead of scrolling, so they are ready when you reach them.
- More scores are looked up at the same time, and titles without a release year no longer slow down the rest.
- Live TV: the country shortcut now follows your own country (SIM, mobile network or device region) instead of always showing the Netherlands. It is hidden when the country cannot be determined.
